tutorial: CAM_Walkthrough_for_the_Impatient.md: a block with a rectangular pocket, a job with one tool (number 4, 2 mm/s, 2000 rpm), a Profile and a Pocket (step over 50 %, pattern Offset), then verified and post-processed. The page gives no sizes for the block, so 60 x 40 x 20 with a 30 x 20 x 8 pocket is used.

calls.expect: a new empty document
volume 4800
the walkthrough's part, a block with a rectangular pocket: volume 43200; volumeChange -4800
a 6 mm through hole to drill later (not in the walkthrough)
volume 42634.51

walkthrough steps 3-10 (tool number 4, 2 mm/s = 120 mm/min both ways, 2000 rpm; a 5 mm end mill): job Walkthrough; model (the clone's label); stock size [62, 42, 21], min [-1, -1, 0], max [61, 41, 21]; tool { number 4, diameter 5, feed 120, plunge 120, rpm 2000 }
refused: tool is needed, with what to ask the person

step 12: cutBox min about [-2.5, -2.5, 0] and max about [62.5, 42.5, ...] (the tool's radius outside the 60 x 40 block); cutZ[0] 0 (down to the part's bottom); depths.final 0, depths.start 21 (the stock's top); cutMm above 200 a pass; tool the job's first

steps 13-14 (the pocket's floor, step over 50 %, pattern Offset; the property is ClearingPattern in 1.1, OffsetPattern in 1.0): cutZ[0] 12; depths.final 12; faces [one face name]; cutBox inside x 15..45, y 10..30 by the tool's radius

refused before FreeCAD computes it: faces Face1 stands upright and closes round no pocket (an outside face is no pocket); nothing kept; no "EdgeWalker has no edges to load" traceback in the Report view (window round 7, 09-014)
refused: side is outside | inside
ops: Profile and Pocket (2 operations), each with cutMm, minutes, cutZ; minutes total above 0; stock size [62, 42, 21]

verdict clear; no crashes; no gouge; part.left.most about 9.0 at a pocket corner (stock top 21 down to the floor at 12 where the 5 mm tool cannot reach the square corner); removedMm3 above 3800 for the pocket; picture: a PNG path

via job; units mm (G21); tools [{ name, number 4 }]; fixtures ['G54']; ops [Profile, Pocket]; lines above 50; no warnings. The file has G21, G54, a tool change 'M6 T4', the profile's last pass at Z0.000 and the pocket's at Z12.000, and ends M2
the same job for grbl: via job; the tool change is a comment '(M6 T4)' unless the job's arguments say --tool-change; G21
refused: post is one of grbl, linuxcnc, mach3_mach4, marlin, smoothie, centroid, generic
tool { name 'Drill 5', number 2, diameter 5 }; tools [first, Drill 5]; no skipped (a drill's angle is its TipAngle in 1.1)
number 3; skipped ['cornerRadius'] (a v-bit has none)
the 6 mm hole found: cutBox min x and y 7; cutZ[0] 0 or lower (the drill's tip); tool 'Drill 5'
dressup label; on Profile; tags 4 (or one off); after.cutMm close to before.cutMm. object_get of the dressup shows Width 6 mm and Height 3 mm (they were reset to FreeCAD's defaults before the fix)
fixtures [G54, G55]; coolant { mode Flood, ops 2 or 3 (those that have a coolant mode) }; safeHeightOffset 5; clearanceOffset 10; the note about ops following the setup sheet
op 'Optional stop'; gcode ['(check the part)', 'M1']; ops in order with it after Pocket
active false; ops shows 'Drill (off)'
fixtures [G54, G55]: the file runs the job twice, once after G54 and once after G55; M8 (flood) appears; M1 after the pocket; no drilling cycle (Drill is off); tools has only number 4
active true
tools: three records; shapes endmill, drill, v-bit (they were all 'endmill' before the fix); Drill 5 has angle 118, Vee 60 angle 60; no step recorded
tool.feed 150; every op computed again (cam_list minutes drop)
object 'Hard stop'; first has M0; job Walkthrough
refused: the message lists the work offsets FreeCAD has (G54 ... G59.9)
bag 'Limits'; name (its internal name for expressions); properties [MaxDepth, Passes]
template: a path ending job_Walkthrough.json; tools 3; the file holds the tool controllers, stock and setup sheet
removed: the tag dressup and Profile (the whole stack); ops no longer lists either
ops: Pocket, Optional stop, Drill, Hard stop

notCovered: cam_op kinds adaptive, face, helix, engrave, vcarve, slot, deburr, thread, surface, waterline, pocket3d, tapping, probe, custom: the walkthrough has only Profile and Pocket (tests/test_cam.py and test_cam_more.py cover adaptive finish, pocket3d, probe, custom)
cam_dressup dogbone, boundary, array, ramp, leadinout
cam_library import; cam_edit copy, comment, start; cam_setup order
cam_path area, from_shape, edges (not on 1.1 without its window), compound, array (tests/test_cam_more.py covers area, compound, array)
sending G-code to a machine: no tool does; it is the person's step
